articles.title: MSF Urges Civilian Protection After Deadly Shelling in Myanmar's Sittwe
articles.description: Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) has called on all warring parties in Rakhine State to protect civilians following a deadly attack in the state capital. An October 23 shelling in Sittwe killed at least two people and injured 17 others, with most casualties occurring at a busy downtown junction. The medical aid group stated on October 24. MSF said its team in central Sittwe heard heavy, sustained shelling, gunfire, and aircraft overhead before learning of the casualties.
